Size guide

Find your fit

Every piece carries its own measurements in AU sizes, shown in inches and centimetres. Measure over light clothing, keep the tape level, then compare with the chart on the piece you love.

  • BustAround the fullest part of the chest.
  • WaistAt the natural waist, the narrowest point.
  • HipAround the fullest part of the hips.
  • LengthFrom the high point of the shoulder down to the hem.
  • SleeveFrom the shoulder seam to the wrist bone.
Our story

Coverage, made beautiful

Zainaé is western modest wear for women who dress with intention. Long hemlines, high necklines and full sleeves, cut to drape softly instead of cling, so every piece feels as considered as it looks.

From occasion gowns to everyday co-ord sets, each piece is made to be worn on its own or layered, from the office to the evening.

Full coverageHigh necks, long sleeves and floor or ankle lengths.
Made to moveFluid shapes that fall softly and travel well.
One piece or twoGowns for occasions, coordinated sets for every day.
